title: Honest strategy test
question: Does the rule work across many stocks, or was one result luck?

tables.title: SMA crossover: strategy vs buy-and-hold (costs 5+5 bps per trade)

findings: The SMA crossover rule beat buy-and-hold out-of-sample on 0 of 1 stocks (over the full period on 0 of 1).
Most simple rules fail to beat buy-and-hold once costs are included. Showing that honestly is more credible than one lucky backtest.
notes: Signals act at the next close; the first 70% is the training period, the rest is out-of-sample. Prices are dividend-adjusted.

sources.label: Yahoo Finance prices (adjusted for splits and dividends)
